targets.query:
from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.type =~ /InfoOnlyAnalog|IRoomController|IRoomControllerV2/ and r.room =~ /^${room:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "value" or r.state == "tempActual")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.room + " " + r.control}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.room =~ /^${room:regex}$/ and r.category =~ /^${category:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.control + " / " + r.state}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.room =~ /^${room:regex}$/ and r.category =~ /^${category:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["room", "control", "state", "_value", "_time"])
  |> group()
